decisions.evidence: Overall, the very low lipophilicity together with the high ionization, high donor burden, and multiple acidic and polar features make inhibition of SARS-CoV-2 replication unlikely, so the molecule is best classified as option (A): does not inhibit SARS-CoV-2 replication.
The six neighbors therefore combine to support option (A): does not inhibit SARS-CoV-2 replication.
